summary: Used the remaining allocation on a network-exercised measurement of the read-index growth trigger, which earlier receipts had only modelled by withholding responses. The harness elects leader 1 in a real three-node network so the log commits and committedEntryInCurrentTerm is true, isolates both followers with the network helper so no acknowledgement can return, and submits 32 same-context ReadIndex requests while counting the heartbeats the leader emits. A local run records unconfirmed 32 with confirmed 0 while still StateLeader, and 64 heartbeat messages - one broadcast to each of the two peers per request - which both exercises the trigger through a real network configuration and refines the amplification figure from a single message per retry to one per peer, so outbound traffic scales with the voter count. Submitted as a fixed experiment for ee850f515b5d49718d5f55c4c1d36e61-question-0 with scope, prefix, an in-term prerequisite and two comparisons (unconfirmed 32, broadcasts 64) plus the two supporting facts as knowledge uses; no interpretation is added because the receipt does not exist yet. The other threads, including the two asserted defects and the measured StateSnapshot repair exits, are unchanged.
